crossrefs.text: Mount Sinai was completely enveloped in smoke, because the LORD had descended on it in fire. And the smoke rose like the smoke of a furnace, and the whole mountain quaked violently.
O LORD, when You went out from Seir, when You marched from the land of Edom, the earth trembled, the heavens poured out rain, and the clouds poured down water.
The mountains quaked before the LORD, the One of Sinai, before the LORD, the God of Israel.
Then Moses stretched out his hand over the sea, and all that night the LORD drove back the sea with a strong east wind that turned it into dry land. So the waters were divided,
When all the people witnessed the thunder and lightning, the sounding of the ramʼs horn, and the mountain enveloped in smoke, they trembled and stood at a distance.
The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths were shaken.
He stood and measured the earth; He looked and startled the nations; the ancient mountains crumbled; the perpetual hills collapsed. His ways are everlasting.
I looked at the earth, and it was formless and void; I looked to the heavens, and they had no light.
He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.
Then Moses raised his hand and struck the rock twice with his staff, so that a great amount of water gushed out, and the congregation and their livestock were able to drink.
He led you through the vast and terrifying wilderness with its venomous snakes and scorpions, a thirsty and waterless land. He brought you water from the rock of flint.
The foundations of heaven quake, astounded at His rebuke.
He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
If only You would rend the heavens and come down, so that mountains would quake at Your presence,
When You did awesome works that we did not expect, You came down, and the mountains trembled at Your presence.

Do you not fear Me?” declares the LORD. “Do you not tremble before Me, the One who set the sand as the boundary for the sea, an enduring barrier it cannot cross? The waves surge, but they cannot prevail. They roar but cannot cross it.
